author: Suisse Pratique mit Dragan
text:
Swiss health insurance explained for expats (2026)
Moving to Switzerland? In this video I explain basic vs supplementary insurance, deductibles, models and how I chose between CSS, SWICA and others. Not financial advice, just my experience. Supplementary insurance requires a health declaration, so apply while you're healthy. Basic insurance is the same by law everywhere, the differences are service and supplementary products.
rationale: Positive YouTube video about switching insurer. No reputational, conduct, market-abuse or cyber risk signals.
